data.standardized_narrative: The syndicate experienced an overall net release of GBP 1.922 million in prior year reserves. This was driven by a GBP 5.890 million improvement on reinsurance acceptances, partially offset by deteriorations of GBP 1.621 million in Marine, Aviation and Transport and GBP 2.094 million in Fire and other damage to property. Favourable development was noted for Superstorm Sandy, Oxbow mining, and Canadian floods from the 2012 year of account. The 2013 year of account developed as anticipated, with larger losses like the Blue Racer midstream vapour cloud explosion, Julius Klein diamond theft, and EIF Risk Management turbine damage falling within reinsurance retentions.
